evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Ratification language performs the settling of a contract; the speaker records a decision as made, not argued for.
Operational guarantee stated as a settled rule with no hedging; the speaker asserts a load-bearing invariant of the ratified contract, not a position still open to debate.
